label: EXPERIMENTAL snowpack-structure prediction for expert decision support. Not an avalanche forecast, danger rating or operational guidance.

input_provenance.description: SYNTHETIC - invented for software demonstration; not real terrain, weather or observations
notes: synthetic forecast with deliberate timing/amount error

capability.transport_note: Independent terrain-conditioned columns. No wind erosion/deposition between units; lee-slope loading is NOT represented and must not be inferred from exposure.
capability.instability_note: No calibrated instability classifier is available. Candidate weak layers are grain-form based structure flags, not instability or danger.
capability.hardness_source: SNOWPACK hand-hardness parameterization (uncalibrated for this region)
capability.uncertainty_note: Ensemble spread is scenario uncertainty from configured perturbations; it is not a calibrated probability or a confidence guarantee.

forcing_assumptions: PSUM supplied to the engine per slope-parallel area (horizontal flux x cos slope)
air temperature lapse rate -6.50 K/km (fallback; not locally estimated)
diffuse SW isotropic, scaled by unit sky-view factor; terrain-reflected SW = albedo 0.6 x global x (1 - sky view)
direct/diffuse split ESTIMATED from global horizontal SW via Erbs et al. (1982)
incoming LW = sky view x source ILWR + (1 - sky view) x emission from terrain at min(TA, 0 C) (simplified)
lower boundary: constant ground temperature 273.15 K (TSG), no soil layers
precipitation phase: linear air-temperature ramp 0.2..2.2 C at unit elevation (UNCALIBRATED placeholder; wet-bulb scheme pending verification)
relative humidity adjusted by conserving source dewpoint (Magnus over water); RH capped at 100%
source shortwave assumed unobstructed global horizontal radiation at the source location
wind speed and direction passed through without terrain downscaling
